sources.title: Boy, 11, killed after being hit by ute in regional WA
South Africa's first female deputy president and UN official dies

en.title: Eleven-year-old boy killed in regional WA crash; South Africa's first female deputy president dies
en.dek: An 11-year-old boy died after being hit by a ute in Kirup; Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, South Africa's first female deputy president and UN official, died at 71.
facts: An 11-year-old boy was struck by a Toyota Hilux ute on South Western Highway in Kirup, Western Australia, on Friday evening and later died in hospital.
The boy was flown to Perth Children's Hospital; the 25-year-old female ute driver was uninjured and assisting police.
Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, 71, died on Friday; she was South Africa's first female deputy president, serving from 2005 to 2008.
Mlambo-Ngcuka also served as UN under-secretary-general and executive director of UN Women, roles she held from 2013.
The Kirup crash occurred near the Dark Down South music festival; event organisers confirmed no attendees were involved.
body: An 11-year-old boy died after being hit by a Toyota Hilux ute on South Western Highway in the small town of Kirup, Western Australia, on Friday evening. The boy was flown to Perth Children's Hospital, where he later died, while the 25-year-old female driver was uninjured and assisting police with inquiries.

Rachel Woods, a Kirup resident who witnessed the aftermath, said she heard a screech of brakes and a crunching sound and saw the boy and his mother on the road being attended to by first responders. Event traffic managers from the Dark Down South music festival were among the first on the scene, though organisers said no attendees were involved in the incident.

Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, who served as South Africa's first female deputy president from 2005 to 2008, died at the age of 71. The presidency announced her death late on Friday, noting she also served as UN under-secretary-general and executive director of UN Women.

Before her deputy presidency, Mlambo-Ngcuka served as minister of minerals and energy and deputy minister in the Department of Trade and Industry. She was elected to parliament in 1994 in South Africa's first democratic government and took office as executive director of UN Women in August 2013.
en.context: The Western Australia crash occurred on a highway near a music festival, with the community having previously lobbied for a lower speed limit. Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka was a prominent figure in South Africa's post-apartheid government and global gender equality advocacy.
en.imageCaption: Executive Director of UN Women Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka attends the Women's Forum Americas, at Claustro de Sor Juana University in Mexico City, Mexico, May 30, 2019.

pt.title: Menino de onze anos morre num acidente regional em WA; falecimento da primeira vice-presidente feminina da África do Sul
pt.dek: Um menino de 11 anos morreu após ser atingido por uma viatura em Kirup; Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, primeira vice-presidente feminina da África do Sul e funcionária da ONU, faleceu aos 71 anos.
facts: Um menino de 11 anos foi atingido por uma Toyota Hilux na South Western Highway em Kirup, Austrália Ocidental, na sexta-feira à noite e morreu mais tarde no hospital
O menino foi transportado para o Perth Children's Hospital; a condutora da viatura, uma mulher de 25 anos, não se feriu e prestou assistência à polícia
Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, 71 anos, faleceu na sexta-feira; foi a primeira vice-presidente feminina da África do Sul, no período de 2005 a 2008
Mlambo-Ngcuka também exerceu o cargo de subsecretária-geral da ONU e diretora executiva da ONU Mulheres, funções que deteve a partir de 2013
O acidente em Kirup ocorreu perto do festival de música Dark Down South; os organizadores do evento confirmaram que nenhum participante foi envolvido.
body: Um menino de onze anos morreu após ser atropelado por um Toyota Hilux na South Western Highway, na pequena cidade de Kirup, na Austrália Ocidental, na sexta-feira à noite. A criança foi levada ao Hospital Infantil de Perth, onde mais tarde faleceu, enquanto a motorista de 25 anos, mulher, ficou ilesa e está a colaborar com as investigações.

Rachel Woods, residente de Kirup, disse ter ouvido o som de travões a chirrir e um ruído de impacto e viu o menino e a mãe na estrada a ser assistidos por serviços de emergência. Gestores de tráfego do festival de música Dark Down South foram entre os primeiros no local, embora os organizadores tenham afirmado que nenhum frequentador do evento esteve envolvido no incidente.

Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, que serviu como primeira vice-presidente feminina da África do Sul de 2005 a 2008, morreu aos 71 anos. A presidência anunciou a sua morte na sexta-feira à noite, referindo que também foi subsecretário-geral da ONU e diretora executiva da ONU Mulheres.

Antes do cargo de vice-presidente, Mlambo-Ngcuka foi ministra de Minerais e Energia e vice-ministra no Departamento de Comércio e Indústria. Foi eleita para o parlamento em 1994, no primeiro governo democrático da África do Sul, e assumiu o cargo de diretora executiva da ONU Mulheres em agosto de 2013.
pt.context: O acidente em Austrália Ocidental ocorreu numa autoestrada perto de um festival de música, após a comunidade ter pressionado previamente por um limite de velocidade mais baixo. Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka foi uma figura proeminente no governo sul-africano pós-apartheid e na defesa global da igualdade de género.
pt.imageCaption: A Diretora Executiva da ONU Mulheres, Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, participa no Women's Forum Americas, na Claustro de Sor Juana University, Cidade do México, México, a 30 de maio de 2019.

ko.title: 11세 소년 킵루 충돌 사망…남아프리카 첫 여성 부통령 별세
ko.dek: 11세 소년, 킵루서 유에이치 충돌 후 병원서 사망…남아프리카 첫 여성 부통령·UN 관료 숙비-엠람보-응쿠카 별세
facts: 11세 소년이 금요일 서호주 킵루 남서부 고속도로에서 토요타 힐럭에 치어 병원에서 사망함
소년은 퍼스 어린이 병원으로 후송됐으며, 25세 여성 운전자는 부상당하지 않고 경찰 협조 중
숙비-엠람보-응쿠카는 71세로 금요일 별세했으며, 남아프리카 첫 여성 부통령(2005~2008년 재임)
그녀는 UN 차관보 및 UN 여성대표부 수장을 2013년부터 역임
킵루 충돌은 다크 다운 사우스 음악축제 근처에서 발생했으며, 주최측은 참석자 연관성 부인
body: 11세 소년이 킵루의 남서부 고속도로에서 금요일 저녁 토요타 힐럭 픽업트럭에 치여 사망했다. 소년은 퍼스 어린이 병원으로 옮겨졌으나 결국 숨졌으며, 부상당한 운전자 25세 여성은 경찰 협조 중이다.
킨루 주민 레이첼 우즈는 목격자로서 사고 후 상황을 설명했다. 그녀는 브레이크가 screeching 소리를 듣고 소년이 어머니와 함께 도로 위에서 응급 구조대원들에 의해 치료받는 것을 목격했다. 다크 다운 사우스 음악 페스티벌의 교통 관리자들이 현장에 가장 먼저 도착했지만, 주최측은 해당 사고에 참석자는 없었다고 밝혔다.
남아프리카 최초의 여성 부통령인 푀무질레 마람보-응쿠가가 71세의 나이로 별세했다. 대통령실은 금요일 늦게 그녀의 사망 소식을 전했으며, 그녀는 UN 차관보와 UN 여성 총괄이사도 역임했다고 밝혔다.
부통령 재임 전, 마람보-응쿠가는 광물 및 에너지 장관과 무역산업부 차관을 역임했다. 그녀는 1994년 남아프리카 최초의 민주정부에서 의회에 선출되었으며, 2013년 8월 UN 여성 총괄이사로 취임했다.
ko.context: 서호주 충돌은 음악축제 인근 고속도에서 발생했으며, 지역사회는 이전에 속도 제한 인하를 요구해온 바 있음 || 숙비-엠람보-응쿠카는 남아프리카 pós-apartheid 정부 및 글로벌 성평등 옹호의 prominent 인물임
ko.imageCaption: 2019년 5월 30일, 멕시코시티 클라우스트로 데 소 후아나 대학교에서 열린 여성 포럼 아메리카스에 참석한 UN 여성대표부 수장 숙비-엠람보-응쿠카

de.title: Elfjähriger Junge bei Unfall in WA getötet; Südafrikas erste Vizepräsidentin stirbt
de.dek: Elfjähriger Junge nach Zusammenstoß mit einem Pick-up in Kirup gestorben; Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, Südafrikas erste Vizepräsidentin und UN-Beamtin, stirbt mit 71
facts: Elfjähriger Junge wurde am Freitagabend auf der South Western Highway in Kirup von einem Toyota Hilux Pick-up erfasst und starb später im Krankenhaus.
Junge wurde nach Perth Children's Hospital geflogen; 25-jährige Pick-up-Fahrin blieb unverletzt und half der Polizei.
Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, 71, starb am Freitag; sie war Südafrikas erste Vizepräsidentin und amtierte von 2005 bis 2008.
Mlambo-Ngcuka war zudem UN-Untersekretärin und Leiterin von UN Frauen, Ämter, die sie seit 2013 bekleidete.
Der Unfall in Kirup fand in der Nähe des Musikfestivals Dark Down South statt; Veranstalter bestätigten, dass keine Festivalbesucher involviert waren.
body: Ein elfjähriger Junge starb nach einem Zusammenstoß mit einem Toyota Hilux auf der South Western Highway in der kleinen Ortschaft Kirup in Westaustralien am Freitagabend. Der Junge wurde per Hubschrauber in das Perth Children's Hospital gebracht, wo er später verstarb, während die 25-jährige Fahrerin unverletzt blieb und der Polizei bei den Ermittlungen half.

Rachel Woods, eine Bewohnerin von Kirup, sagte, sie habe einen quietschenden Reifen und ein Knacken gehört und den Jungen sowie seine Mutter auf der Straße gesehen, die von Ersthelfern versorgt wurden. Verkehrsmanager des Musikfestivals Dark Down South waren unter den ersten vor Ort, obwohl die Organisatoren angaben, dass keine Festivalbesucher am Vorfall beteiligt waren.

Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, die von 2005 bis 2008 als erste Vizepräsidentin Südafrikas amtierte, starb im Alter von 71 Jahren. Die Präsidentschaft gab ihren Tod am Freitagabend bekannt und würdigte, dass sie zudem Untersekretärin der Vereinten Nationen und Executive Director von UN Women war.

Bevor sie Vizepräsidentin wurde, bekleidete Mlambo-Ngcuka die Ämter Ministerin für Mineralien und Energie sowie Stellvertretende Ministerin im Department of Trade and Industry. Sie wurde 1994 in das Parlament gewählt und gehörte damit zur ersten demokratischen Regierung Südafrikas und übernahm 2013 den Posten als Executive Director von UN Women.
de.context: Der Unfall in Western Australia ereignete sich auf einer Straße nahe eines Musikfestivals; die Gemeinde hatte zuvor für ein Tempolimit geworben. Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka war eine prominente Figur in der südafrikanischen Nach-Apartheid-Politik und für globale Gleichstellung der Geschlechter.
de.imageCaption: Exekutivdirektorin von UN Frauen Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka besucht das Women's Forum Americas am Claustro de Sor Juana University in Mexiko-Stadt, Mexiko, 30. Mai 2019.

ja.title: 11歳の少年が西オーストラリア州クラッシュで死亡、南アフリカ初の女性副大統領が死去
ja.dek: 11歳の少年がクラッシュで死亡；南アフリカ初の女性副大統領フムジレ・ムラムボ＝ンクラカ死去
facts: 11歳の少年が西オーストラリア州クラッシュで死亡；南アフリカ初の女性副大統領フムジレ・ムラムボ＝ンクラカ死去
11歳の少年が南西ハイウェイでトラックにはねられ、病院で死亡。25歳の女性ドライバーは無傷で警察協力
フムジレ・ムラムボ＝ンクラカ死去。南アフリカ初の女性副大統領で2005年から2008年まで在任
ムラムボ＝ンクラカは2013年からUN事務次長兼UN女性機関長を務めていた
クラッシュはダークダウンソウ音楽祭近くで発生；主催者は出演者に関与していないと明かした
body: 西オーストラリア州クラッシュで11歳の少年死亡、南アフリカ初の女性副大統領が死去 An 11-year-old boy died after being hit by a Toyota Hilux ute on South Western Highway in the small town of Kirup, Western Australia, on Friday evening. The boy was flown to Perth Children's Hospital, where he later died, while the 25-year-old female driver was uninjured and assisting police with inquiries.

キルプ住民が目撃、音楽祭のイベント管理者が現場に Rachel Woods, a Kirup resident who witnessed the aftermath, said she heard a screech of brakes and a crunching sound and saw the boy and his mother on the road being attended to by first responders. Event traffic managers from the Dark Down South music festival were among the first on the scene, though organisers said no attendees were involved in the incident.

南アフリカ初の女性副大統領、71歳で死去 Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, who served as South Africa's first female deputy president from 2005 to 2008, died at the age of 71. The presidency announced her death late on Friday, noting she also served as UN under-secretary-general and executive director of UN Women.

政界経歴、UN女性総監督に Before her deputy presidency, Mlambo-Ngcuka served as minister of minerals and energy and deputy minister in the Department of Trade and Industry. She was elected to parliament in 1994 in South Africa's first democratic government and took office as executive director of UN Women in August 2013.
ja.context: 西オーストラリア州のクラッシュは音楽祭近くの道路で発生し、地域住民は以前から速度制限の引き下げを訴えていた。ムラムボ＝ンクラカは南アフリカのアパルトヘイト後の政府で著名な人物であり、世界的なジェンダー平等擁護活動家だった。
